## Change and evidence

- **Outcome:** <!-- What changed and why does it help? -->
- **Not in scope:** <!-- Key exclusions; N/A for a straightforward small change -->
- **Related Issue/PR:** <!-- Optional for routine bounded work; link when it coordinates a real dependency -->
- **Changed contracts / shared surfaces:** <!-- Canonical files, schemas, admission, CI or none -->
- **Current base / exact head:** <!-- Commit IDs when known, especially for scientific or rights-bearing changes -->

## Verification

- **Tests and exact-head CI:** <!-- Commands, pass/fail/skip, links; never claim work not run -->
- **Diff and collision check:** <!-- What was reviewed; overlapping open PRs/coordination or none -->
- **What remains unverified:** <!-- External bytes, availability, science, limits or N/A -->

- [ ] The diff contains no secrets, private endpoints, customer/claims/portfolio material, unapproved raw source bytes or proprietary assets.
- [ ] Where required, repository-authored files have SPDX/REUSE metadata and canonical/derived views are synchronized.
- [ ] Tests and review evidence are accurately reported; unexecuted checks and unresolved blockers are explicit.

## Source, licensing and scientific claims (when applicable)

<!-- For routine non-source changes: N/A. Do not change model admission through a PR description. -->

- **Exact provider / product / version / source-byte identity:**
- **Rights, permitted use, privacy and admission before → after:**
- **Units, CRS, time, uncertainty, missingness and independent validation:**
- **Unresolved source/science/legal blockers:**

## Risk and review (when applicable)

<!-- Use AGENTS.md proportional-risk guidance, not mandatory agent ceremony.
     Routine and reversible changes: state "Routine: diff + checks".
     High-impact science/rights/security/admission: identify independent reviewer,
     falsification attempt, decision and unresolved blocker accurately.
     Never represent another agent or approval as having occurred if it did not. -->

- **Risk/review approach:**
- **Independent challenge or reason it is pending:** <!-- N/A for routine changes -->
- **Blocking findings / follow-up:** <!-- No open blocker / exact linked Issue and next action -->
